title: Castle Toss
objective: Launch boulders from a slingshot to topple structures and knock out all Gloomling monsters and the boss across 3 levels.
controls: Drag back on the slingshot and release to aim and fire boulders; tap mid-air to trigger Split Shot when unlocked.
core_loop: Aim and fire boulders at monster-filled structures to destroy them, earn coins, and pick upgrades between levels.
features: Destructible wood, stone, and ice blocks
progression: 3 levels escalating from simple wooden platforms to multi-material towers with TNT and a crowned red boss, with upgrade choices after each cleared level.
hook_idea: Fire Bomb Split Shot triggering a TNT chain reaction and Triple KO against the boss tower at t=27.2s-30.4s
